description: Data for: A loop-analysis theory based power flow method and its linear formulation for low-voltage DC Networks is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Hongwei Li. the AC balanced 33bus, 69bus, 135bus, 416bus and 874bus networks data. and 21bus test system composed of two voltage-controlled sources, but they are modified and used as test systems in my paper. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
